alt_text: The main message is Attention Is All You Need: The End of Recurrence. The page features an abstract illustration of interconnected shapes.
Transformers overcome the sequential bottleneck of recurrent models by enabling parallel processing, as shown in the evolution diagram.
The Transformer architecture relies solely on attention mechanisms. The diagram illustrates the model's structure, showing input and output embeddings through attention layers.
Diagram illustrating the Transformer Encoder Structure. It shows Scaled Dot-Product Attention and Multi-Head Attention mechanisms for self-attention layers.
The multi-head self-attention mechanism processes queries, keys, and values through scaled dot-product attention to produce the output representation.
Transformer Translation Results show the model achieved state-of-the-art translation quality, with a BLEU score of 41.0, outperforming previous models.
The Transformer model achieves 92.7 F1 in semi-supervised English constituency parsing, outperforming most models.
Limitations and Future Work. Reducing key size hurts quality, and future work will extend the Transformer to other modalities using local attention mechanisms.
The Transformer achieves state-of-the-art results on WMT 2014 tasks and trains significantly faster than recurrent or convolutional architectures.
